The woman turns towards him with a friendly, wide-eyed expression and holds up a white branded package labeled 'COEGG UNDERWEAR.' The lighting is bright indoor gym lighting, creating clear visibility of her facial features and gestures. (3) The man displays various gym machines on his phone, but the woman repeatedly swipes through his photo gallery to reveal shirtless photos of a muscular man. She smiles flirtatiously, points at the screen with manicured nails, and leans in closer to inspect the images while the man attempts to swipe back to the equipment. (4) The scene shifts to showing her leading the man into the main gym area. She grabs his forearm with a cheerful smile, looking back at the camera. In the background, other gym-goers are visible using weight machines and benches in a spacious, professionally equipped fitness center.
